evals.prompt: Use @ws-monitor for a typical monitor task in this project.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads ws-monitor and follows its skill contract.
assertions: Agent loads ws-monitor before acting
Follows skill steps and Done when criteria
Uses path tokens from tools.md instead of hardcoded consumer paths
Output is en-us and harness-neutral

evals.prompt: /monitor - edge case: missing or incomplete config.json
evals.expected_output: Agent stops or bootstraps via configure-project/setup, not silent guessing.
assertions: Recognizes ws-monitor trigger from slash or @ invocation
References ws-shared/config.json or configure-project when config missing
Does not invent project-specific metadata

evals.prompt: /monitor - a standard run with every step terminal (Step 3 skipped dag-disabled) still reports status: active with endedAt: null
evals.expected_output: Agent reports terminal-run-active, derives a terminal reported status so the run is not counted active, and points at the stale state file.
assertions: Emits the terminal-run-active finding for a terminal-shaped run still reporting active with endedAt null
Does not count a terminal-shaped run in activeCount or report status == active for it
Explains the terminal shape (all steps through the close step terminal) and cites the state file as evidence
Does not modify the state file (read-only observation)

evals.prompt: /monitor - a ws-spec-multi run whose in_progress row's child worker already closed, or a completed run that still lists pending rows
evals.expected_output: Agent reports stale-parent-row for the completed-child / non-terminal parent-row shape.
assertions: Emits stale-parent-row when a queue row is non-terminal while its child workflow is terminal
Emits stale-parent-row when a terminal run still lists pending/in_progress rows (phantom rows)
Emits stale-parent-row when a newer active run claims the same in_progress slug (supersede never retired)
Names the affected slug and cites the queue state file as evidence

evals.prompt: /monitor - a ws-spec-multi run whose shipped/in_progress item left no child state under {plansDir}/{slug}/
evals.expected_output: Agent reports missing-child-state, and the multi-spec expectedArtifacts list is populated from the queue rows instead of empty.
assertions: Emits missing-child-state for an in_progress/shipped/failed item with no child workflow state under {plansDir}/{slug}/

Requires a parseable machine SoT *.state.json with the workflow-identity fields and the item's own slug (a .state.md render, invalid JSON, or a foreign-slug state does not count) and ignores the reserved ws-spec-multi batch directory alias
Populates the ws-spec-multi expectedArtifacts list from the batch queue rows (never an empty list)
Stays silent for a pending/skipped item and for an advanced item whose child state exists
Does not duplicate stale-parent-row, which requires a child that already closed

evals.prompt: /monitor - a fix-PR-only run (completedSteps [8, 9], empty plan dir), a terminal run with step-02 refined plan but no interview registry, and a sparse-steps run with a high currentStep
evals.expected_output: Agent reports zero critical missing-artifact findings on all three shapes; the interview drift is at most info citing the refined companion as evidence.
assertions: Emits zero critical missing-artifact / missing-exec-artifact for the fix-PR-only, terminal-drift, and sparse-steps shapes
Reports the terminal interview-registry drift as info (never critical), citing the refined plan as interview evidence
Still emits critical missing-artifact for a genuinely live run past verification without artifacts
Does not modify any state file (read-only observation)

evals.prompt: /monitor - an active workflow with --discover-host-transcripts plus an explicit transcript root on a host with a large nested session history, whose correlated session is idle beyond the stall window
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the correlated session within the tick (filesScanned >= 1), resolves transcriptSource available, and raises worker-session-stall.
assertions: Reports filesScanned >= 1 and transcriptSource available for the correlated session despite the discovery flood
Never reports scan-capped / no-matching-session for a session the scan filter counted
Emits worker-session-stall for the idle correlated session on the active workflow
Does not modify any state file (read-only observation)

evals.prompt: /monitor - a single merged transcript root where the path-correlated session (us-419) sorts last by mtime behind unrelated history (us-419 intra-root enumeration edge)
evals.expected_output: Agent still reads the correlated session (filesScanned >= 1) because enumeration correlates on the path under a hard bound instead of stopping at the per-root slice.
assertions: Reports filesScanned >= 1 for the correlated session despite it sorting after the per-root slice
Keeps capped honest when the enumeration bound truncates
Does not modify any state file (read-only observation)
